title: The Generalized Volterra Signature
abstract: arXiv:2611.31967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce the generalized Volterra signature \(\gvsig(\bX)\) of a path \(\bX\), extending the classical Volterra signature introduced in [Hager, Harang, Pelizzari \& Tindel, arXiv:2603.04525, 2026], which extends Lyons' path signature to the Volterra setting. We establish a new algebraic structure to encode the generalized Volterra signature. We also establish a generalized Chen's identity. By restricting the differential trees to ladder trees, we introduce the geometric Volterra signature \(\geovsig(\bX)\) and establish the shuffle product of its signature components. To the best of our knowledge, the shuffle product for the Volterra signature is the first of its kind and allows us to formulate a universal approximation theorem for geometric Volterra signatures. translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们引入了路径 \(\bX\) 的广义Volterra签名 \(\gvsig(\bX)\)，它扩展了 [Hager, Harang, Pelizzari & Tindel, arXiv:2603.04525, 2026] 中引入的经典Volterra签名，而后者将Lyons的路径签名推广到了Volterra情形。我们建立了一种新的代数结构来编码广义Volterra签名，并建立了一个广义的Chen恒等式。通过将微分树限制为梯形树，我们引入了几何Volterra签名 \(\geovsig(\bX)\)，并建立了其签名分量之间的shuffle积（洗牌积）。据我们所知，这是首个针对Volterra签名的shuffle积，并使我们能够为几何Volterra签名提出一个万能逼近定理。对于一类特殊的核函数，我们证明了扩展路径 \(\Bar{\bX}\) 的存在性，并将其经典签名与几何Volterra签名联系起来。
tldr: 本文提出广义Volterra签名及其新的代数编码结构与广义Chen恒等式，并首次建立了几何Volterra签名的shuffle积，从而导出其万能逼近定理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the generalized Volterra signature with a new algebraic structure and a generalized Chen's identity, and establishes the first shuffle product for geometric Volterra signatures, enabling a universal approximation theorem.
